name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2023 in Intrusions (ICS)
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK for ICS techniques from the 2023 record: the ids ATT&CK's G1027 page prints for the CyberAv3ngers Unitronics activity of November 2023 (campaign C0031), and the ids Mandiant's 9 November 2023 report on Sandworm's attack on a Ukrainian substation prints. Revoked ids are shown under their v20.0 successors. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2023.md. Scores: 100 an opened source or ATT&CK object prints the id.
